pageCache.pageTitle: Headteacher's Welcome | Callis Grange Nursery and Infant School
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
Headteacher's Welcome
Welcome to Callis Grange
Whether you are an existing parent of the school, a prospective parent or a visitor to our website, we warmly welcome you and thank you for your interest in Callis Grange Nursery and Infant School.
It is intended that this website will provide you with some basic and useful information about our school. If you are a parent of Callis Grange and require a paper copy of any information on the website, this is available free of charge on request.
Callis Grange Nursery and Infant School is a happy school in which we hope the children will feel secure and confident. Children are encouraged to take positive attitudes towards learning and to achieve the highest standards in all that they do. I am happy to share with you our Parent Case Studies which give you the views of some of our parents. I hope you enjoying reading them. Please click the linkbelow:
Callis Grange was last Inspected in April 2022 and was graded as a “Good" school with "Outstanding" personal development and behaviour and attitudes. Ofsted stated that:
"Pupils feel safe and enjoy coming to school."
"There is a positive and friendly buzz in the school."
"Leaders have high aspirations for all pupils."
"Leaders have planned an ambitious and broad curriculum, so that all pupils learn and achieve well."
"Behaviour at the school is exemplary."
Callis Grange is also proud to have received a number of awards which you can read about on our website.
Parent Case Studies
I look forward to meeting both current and new parents during the academic year. If you, as a parent/carer, wish to view the school or have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Mrs V Palmer-Simpson BA (Hons) PgDip CMgr FCMI
